text:
maria.p: Quick sync — I'm kicking off the infra strategy doc for 'tenant gating + routing convergence'. Need input on launch criteria, required SLAs, and top customer asks by EOD Friday. High level goals: predictable latency <100ms p50 for hosted tier, isolation lanes for regulated customers, routing fallback policy for region failures.
ashwin: :+1: are we prioritizing strong affinity or cost efficiency first? they pull in opposite directions.
sophia: For Dedicated customers we promised <50ms p95 in our deck. That affects how many isolation lanes we need.
carl: If we require regional strict isolation (VPC-only) that's extra ops for upgrades. We should define 'isolation tiers' not binary.
maria.p: Agree. Proposal: three tiers — shared, soft-isolation, hard-isolation. Define launch acceptance per tier: traffic % cap, supported features, rollback plan.
ashwin: Can we sketch acceptance criteria? e.g., for soft-isolation: p99 < 300ms, no cross-tenant dataflow, automated evacuation in 3h.
jen: Add: compatibility with model-variant fallback (same family quantized variant) — must be transparent to apps.
maria.p: Good call. Also need runbook for fallback decision tree. cc @deploy-bot for canary options.
deploy-bot: Canary created: canary/tenant-gating-v1 rolling 10% across us-west-2. Logs: http://ci/redwood/canary/1768015555
ashwin: For routing: propose policy precedence: 1) tenant-region affinity, 2) latency cost knob, 3) capacity fallback. Thoughts?
sophia: Precedence seems fine but need an override for compliance-tagged tenants to force region residency.
maria.p: Exactly. Compliance override trumps others. We also need telemetry: per-tenant SLA dashboard + alerting when routing policy demotes to fallback.
carl: Ops ask — migration path for existing tenants. Suggest a 'migration window' with traffic shaping and opt-in. Will draft steps.
jen: Also include sample config (pseudo):
```
routing_policy:
  tiers: [affinity, latency_cost, fallback]
  overrides:
    compliance: ['eu-west-1']
  soft_isolation:
    eviction_timeout: 3h
    max_shared_burst: 20%
```
ashwin: I'll send a short doc with perf modelling numbers (cost vs isolation lanes) by Thursday.
maria.p: Perfect. Goal: doc + acceptance checklist by next Tues. If you have customer asks drop them here. :pray:
mike.sales: FYI — 2 enterprise customers asked for per-region isolation and audit logs. Will post details.
maria.p: Thanks!
